properties.description:
Fourteen tests over `detect_defects` / `open_defects`, in four bands.

THE THREE FIXED KINDS, each with its counterweight: two parked ideas that contradict raise nothing, but two ACCEPTED decisions still do; an anticipation involving a parked idea raises nothing, but one between accepted decisions still does; an island of only parked ideas raises nothing, but an island holding anything asserted still does.

⭐ EACH KIND STATES HOW IT COMBINES THE PREDICATE, AND THEY DIFFER. `contradiction` needs BOTH endpoints parked; `unresolved_setup` skips on EITHER; `unthreaded_cluster` needs EVERY island member. That asymmetry is pinned rather than left to a reader: `an_accepted_decision_anticipating_a_parked_idea_is_not_an_unresolved_setup` and `a_measurement_anticipating_a_parked_idea_is_not_an_unresolved_setup` hold the either-side rule, while `a_parked_idea_against_settled_design_is_still_reported` holds the both-sides rule one detector over. A single rule for all three would break one of them.

⭐ THE SWEEP SAYS WHAT IT DID NOT REPORT. `a_suppressed_finding_is_counted_rather_than_silenced` asserts a skipped finding lands in `SweepScope.suppressed_by_parked_idea`, so `reported + suppressed` reconciles instead of findings vanishing. Its counterweight `a_clean_sweep_reports_nothing_suppressed` asserts the map is EMPTY when nothing was parked — that one is what makes the field trustworthy, because a wired-but-never-incremented field otherwise reads exactly like a design with no parked ideas.

THE ASSUMPTION-KILLERS, all written after a wrong cut. `a_decision_has_no_unlabelled_state` records that `Decision.status` defaults to `proposed`, so silence is unreachable and this change is NOT inert on existing designs; it fails if that schema default ever moves. `a_proposed_requirement_still_asserts` is the scope counterweight: `CONTRADICTS` is `from: "*" to: "*"` and `Requirement.status` also defaults to `proposed`, so the predicate checks the node TYPE — and the TemporalFact case above is why a type-scoped predicate cannot be the whole rule for an edge whose other end is any type.

⭐ THE CLASS GUARD, which is the point. `every_category_states_whether_it_reads_proposed` is an EXHAUSTIVE match over `HealCategory`: a new category cannot compile until its author has written down whether it reads a parked idea. It asserts nothing about the ANSWER — both are legitimate — only that somebody gave one. Sibling of `every_category_is_listed_in_all`, which exists one rule over for the same reason.
properties.findings: 14 passed / 0 failed, after THREE cuts, and every cut was OBSERVED FAILING FIRST. Cut 1: 4 of 10 red, all three finding kinds reproduced, counterweights and the class guard green beforehand so they are not vacuous. Cut 2: two new pins red before `unresolved_setup` widened to either side. Cut 3: `a_suppressed_finding_is_counted_rather_than_silenced` was run against the field wired but the increments deliberately NOT added, and went red for exactly that reason, while its counterweight `a_clean_sweep_reports_nothing_suppressed` was green throughout — which is what distinguishes a counted zero from an uncounted one. Full core suite after: 1504 passed / 0 failed across 130 binaries; `cargo fmt --check` and `clippy -D warnings` clean; all 161 toolsnaps match, since this changes a result shape rather than a tool schema. Measured on reflow2's own design through the served binary: 89 -> 78 -> 61 reported, and the sweep now declares 33 suppressed (contradiction 3, unresolved_setup 27, unthreaded_cluster 3), so reported + suppressed reconciles.
properties.name: A parked idea is not read as a commitment, and every finding kind states where it stands
